title: Common problems with 1.3.4
author: Raspberry
content:
Problems and their fixes:
misisng libc++shared.so: you have a pirated copy, buy the game.
"We only support 26.30": typo, update both flarial and minecraft.
Shaders not working: shader's fault, not us, wait till those shader makers update their pack to work on 26.40.
